description:
Native American Library Services Enhancement Grants (2027)

• The listing agency is Institute of Museum and Library Services.
• Grants.gov lists individual awards from $50,000 to $150,000.
• Grants.gov lists estimated total program funding of $3.5 million.
• Grants.gov lists 25 expected awards.
• Grants.gov lists the close date as November 13, 2026.
• Eligible applicant types listed: Native American tribal governments (Federally recognized).

Official listing: https://www.grants.gov/search-results-detail/363762
Always verify current details on Grants.gov before applying.

segments.voiceover: It's a grant. The program: Native American Library Services Enhancement Grants (2027).
Estimated total funding is $3.5 million, with individual awards from $50,000 to $150,000. Grants.gov expects 25 awards.

on_screen.headline: “The Native American Library Services Enhancement Grants program (NAE) assists eligible Native Communities in sustaining and improving library services with their communities.”

segments.voiceover: In the agency's words: The Native American Library Services Enhancement Grants program (NAE) assists eligible Native Communities in sustaining and improving library services with their communities.
Applications close November 13, 2026. No cost match is required.
Search the opportunity number on Grants.gov, and check the official listing before you apply.

source_note: Source: Grants.gov opportunity NAG-ENHANCEMENT-FY27 (https://www.grants.gov/search-results-detail/363762). Details can change; always verify the official listing before applying.
